#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
lock=$base/.replay.lock

umask 022
mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"

if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' 'replay: another recovery is already running' >&2
    exit 1
fi
trap 'rm -rf "$lock"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=${message##*/}

    if message_id=$(awk '
        BEGIN { count = 0 }
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (line == "")
                exit
            colon = index(line, ":")
            if (colon > 0) {
                field = substr(line, 1, colon - 1)
                gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", field)
                if (tolower(field) == "message-id") {
                    value = substr(line, colon + 1)
                    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", value)
                    count++
                    id = value
                }
            }
        }
        END {
            if (count == 1 && id ~ /^<[^<>[:space:]]+>$/)
                print id
            else
                exit 1
        }
    ' "$message"); then
        :
    else
        qfile=$quarantine/$name
        tmp=$quarantine/.replay.$$.message
        cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
        mv -f -- "$tmp" "$qfile"
        printf '%s\n' 'Malformed message: missing, repeated, or invalid Message-ID header.' > "$qfile.reason"
        printf 'quarantined\t%s\n' "$name"
        continue
    fi

    if awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$message_id" 'NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' "$index"; then
        printf 'skipped\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$name"
        continue
    fi

    target=$delivered/$name
    if [ -e "$target" ]; then
        stem=${name%.eml}
        suffix=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/$stem-$suffix.eml" ]; do
            suffix=$((suffix + 1))
        done
        target=$delivered/$stem-$suffix.eml
    fi

    tmp=$delivered/.replay.$$.message
    cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
    mv -- "$tmp" "$target"
    target_name=${target##*/}
    if ! printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$target_name" >> "$index"; then
        rm -f -- "$target"
        exit 1
    fi
    printf 'delivered\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$target_name"
done
ANTRIEB_REPLAY_EOF
chmod 0755 bin/replay
